title: Operations Automated Work Profiles
boundary: A profile guides questions, routing and expected evidence. It does not change the record type, approve work or grant authority.

profiles.label: Methodology feedback/change
additionalQuestions: Would this change approved meaning, or clarify how existing meaning is applied?
profiles.approvalRoute: Preparation and release are separate founder decisions.
profiles.reviewTrigger: New evidence, repeated friction or an observed harmful result.

profiles.label: Product or application build
additionalQuestions: What result would show that the user can actually complete the journey?
profiles.approvalRoute: Jamie approves release and merge separately after implementation evidence.
completionEvidence: validated acceptance criteria and authorised merge receipt
profiles.reviewTrigger: Failed validation, unresolved risk, version impact or real-use correction.

profiles.label: Branding review
additionalQuestions: Is this an internal-use decision, a revision request or an external-publication decision?
profiles.approvalRoute: Brand review evidence uses the universal approval object; external publication remains separate.
completionEvidence: latest explicit founder result and retained boundary
profiles.reviewTrigger: A revised surface is ready or a later use exposes inconsistency.

profiles.label: Daily methodology challenge
additionalQuestions: Which single judgement could materially change the provisional response?
profiles.approvalRoute: A response is feedback, not approval.
profiles.reviewTrigger: Seven responses are a checkpoint; the cycle continues until explicitly changed.

profiles.label: Research/evidence review
additionalQuestions: What decision could this evidence change?
checklist: Use more than one source type where practical
Separate anecdote, opinion, research and authority
profiles.approvalRoute: Evidence informs a decision; it does not make it.
profiles.reviewTrigger: Material new evidence or a changed decision context.

profiles.label: Documentation/publication
additionalQuestions: Is this preparation, private publication, Live promotion or external publication?
profiles.approvalRoute: Private, Live and external publication remain distinct bounded decisions.
completionEvidence: returned page versions or an explicit no-publication decision
profiles.reviewTrigger: Source change, independent edit, failed first use or expiry.

profiles.label: General administration/to-do
additionalQuestions: Is there a deadline, blocker or wider decision that changes the route?
checklist: Link wider context only when useful
profiles.approvalRoute: Routine completion is not a wider approval.
expectedOutputs: completed task or retained reason for cancellation
profiles.reviewTrigger: The task grows into a Request, Change, Risk or Decision.
